query:
UPDATE rb_frontend_binding b
         SET package_id = $3
         FROM rb_frontend_revision r, rb_frontend_package p
         WHERE b.revision_id = r.id
           AND r.game_id = $1
           AND r.status = 'draft'
           AND b.package_id = p.id
           AND p.game_id = $1
           AND p.name = $2
           AND p.id <> $3
